title: Tech Note: Using 4D with United States Postal Service (USPS) Web Services

historical_commentary.text: This note shows 4D consuming an external government web API (USPS Web Tools) using 4D Internet Commands, one of the earliest examples of 4D-as-a-client integrating with third-party web services rather than only publishing its own. The specific USPS API version and 4D Internet Commands-based HTTP handling from 2004 are dated, but the general pattern of a 4D application calling an external REST/XML API for shipping/address services remains a common and conceptually relevant integration scenario today, now typically done with more modern HTTP/JSON commands.
related_updates: 4D Internet Commands' HTTP/networking capabilities have been substantially extended and partly superseded by newer built-in HTTP client commands and JSON support in later 4D versions
The USPS Web Tools API itself has evolved considerably since 2004, likely requiring different authentication and endpoint details than described in this note
